summary: Verified 7.0/10, NOT on par: no blocker is open, but the score is under 7.5. Confirmed that the GLBs have not changed. git log on art/out/fighters/ilsheta ends at 89112e613 (the GF-1 revert), and the working tree is clean, so the existing renders and the 2026-11-07 RIFT frames are valid evidence. Sensitivity is clean, re-checked by eye. The hood is rounded in all 12 turntable cells and in all three splashes and the portrait. The chimney is a flat-topped open cylinder. The face has pupils, a brow chevron, a nose and a mouth (portrait.png), so it does not read as horror or a mannequin. The pointed spires are background only. Both majors are confirmed. In game (closing_ilsheta2_self_z285_crop.png) she is a hue-less blue-grey bell, and the chimney shows only as an outlined tube. The splash major holds, but the reviewer overstated it. Stillwater has its own plate (a snowy tree-terrace city) and a reaching or pointing pose. The finding holds for base and First Bell: they share one plate regraded to sepia, all three use the static cut-out with a posterise filter, and the lamp never lights the scene. All minors are confirmed against ilsheta_qa.json and turntable.png.

findings.title: The signature chimney reads at the game camera only as a faint outline, and the body is a hue-less grey-white bell
findings.what: At RIFT zoom 28.5 the dawnglass chimney is transparent over the lane stone. It shows only as a white rim ellipse and two thin edges, and has no forward lip to cue facing. The mantle is a blue-grey to white gradient with no hue of its own. The only colour on the figure is the team-tinted lamp, and the ring and nameplate carry the read more than the body does.
findings.evidence: _harness/_shots/closing_ilsheta2_self_z285_crop.png, closing_ilsheta2_ally_z285_crop.png, closing_ilsheta_verify_enemy_z285.png (at 1080p she is a small pale blob next to the saturated orange and brown Wicks); art/renders/fighters/ilsheta/turntable.png (the chimney is clear glass at every facing); _design/fighters/ilsheta.md §1
findings.gauge: In LoL, a champion's signature prop is the brightest or most saturated shape in the top-down silhouette, and the body carries a local hue that identifies the champion in a teamfight. In VALE the defining prop nearly disappears, and the body has no hue of its own.
findings.fix: VALE's own fix: give the game-LOD chimney a frosted dawnglass inner sleeve (about 55% opaque) and a chalk crown band. Add a forward lip along +Y. Warm the upper mantle to linen cream with woven normal detail. Re-gate with the lineup_qa top-down masks: the chimney must be the top-value vertical at 64 px.
findings.verifierNote: I viewed the self crop and the enemy frame myself, and the claim reproduces exactly. The severity is right: this is the fighter's main read at gameplay scale.

findings.title: The splashes are static cut-outs on filtered plates, and base and First Bell share one plate
findings.what: The reviewer's claim that 'all three' are the same frontal stand-and-hold is overstated. Stillwater has its own plate (a snowy tree-terrace city with domes) and a reaching or pointing pose. What still holds: base (hand to chin, lamp held) and First Bell (lamp held out) are standing frontal cut-outs on the same spire, bridge and chasm plate, regraded from blue to sepia. The lamp never lights the scene in any of the three. A posterise smear filter is on every figure. The ground contact is a flat drop shadow.
findings.evidence: art/out/fighters/ilsheta/splash.png, ilsheta_first_bell_splash.png, ilsheta_stillwater_splash.png (viewed at 1x); _harness/_shots/closing_ilsheta3_splash_face.png (smear blotches, cut-out edge)
findings.gauge: A LoL base splash and each skin splash are unique painted compositions with an action beat. The champion's own prop lights the scene, and skin splashes never reuse the base plate.
findings.fix: VALE's own fix: give each splash a beat in which the lamp is a real point light on the plate. Give First Bell its own dawn bell-frame plate. Drop the posterise filter on the figure.
findings.verifierNote: Kept as major. The shared plate, the unlit-lamp cut-out and the filter are reproducible. The finding text is corrected because Stillwater has a distinct plate and pose.

findings.title: The skins differ only by tint and trim
findings.what: First Bell is the base model with an ochre hood. Stillwater is the base with a sea-glass tint and a small reed crown. The silhouette, chimney and lamp are unchanged.
findings.gauge: A LoL priced skin changes at least one silhouette element or prop shape.
findings.fix: Give each skin one new silhouette element: a bell cast in the First Bell lamp cage, and a reed-wrapped staff with a dripping lamp base for Stillwater.

findings.title: The top-down value gradient gate still fails, and the bottom band is just over target
findings.what: valueGradientOk is false on all three variants. At facing 0 the top band is 69.0 against the 70 floor, and the base bottom band is 35.7 against the 20-35 target. At facing 180 the mid band is brighter than the top band.
findings.gauge: A LoL champion reads light at the top and anchored at the feet from every angle.
findings.fix: Lift the hood crown and chimney band by about 3 L*, and darken the hem's cloth3 by about 2 L*.
findings.verifierNote: I read the numbers from the json myself.

findings.title: In the run the lamp swings over the face plate
findings.what: In turntable cell 9 the lamp cage covers the face, and in cell 10 it sits at the chin. The idle is fixed.
findings.gauge: A LoL champion's face and prop stay separated in the locomotion silhouette.
findings.fix: Carry the lamp at hip height in the run, trailing the stride.
findings.verifierNote: Confirmed in the turntable. At the game camera the face is barely legible anyway, so it stays minor.

findings.title: Watch item: at splash scale the plain white oval plate leans doll-like, and the filter blotches the hood edge
findings.what: It is under blocker class: portrait.png shows a brow chevron, a nose, a mouth and eyes with pupils. At 3x in the splash, the plate is flat white with stepped smear blotches. The Stillwater plate is tinted pale green, which pushes it slightly toward ghostly, but it is still a readable face.
findings.gauge: A LoL porcelain or masked face carries sculpted planes and warm local colour.
findings.fix: Paint warm chalk shading into the facets, add a soft occlusion gradient into the hood, and drop the smear filter.
findings.verifierNote: I checked it against the sensitivity rule, and it is not horror, a hockey mask or a mannequin. It stays a minor watch item.
